SB_Theme_CoOccurrence: Within-paper co-emphasis correlation of the ten spaceflight-risk themes across the on-target literature (n=4,415) — which risks are studied together.
SB_Theme_Network: Force-directed theme co-occurrence network; greedy-modularity communities with nodes coloured by 30-year momentum — the falling human-physiology risks form one connected community.
SB_Momentum_Acceleration: Acceleration map: each theme's early (1995–99→2015–19) vs recent (2015–19→2020–24) emphasis momentum — is the drift speeding up or slowing?
SB_Trajectories_Annotated: Five representative emphasis trajectories (1995–2024) annotated with the real-world programmes, facilities and landmark publications that drove them.
SB_Sequencing_Omics: Omics & microbiome literature emphasis against NHGRI cost-per-genome (log, inverted) — the molecular turn as an exogenous, sequencing-cost-driven tide.
Space_Biology_Research_Gap_Report: Where Is Space Biology Going — and Where Should It? Self-contained interactive three-corpus research-gap report (28 figures).
